issues: Medical procedure mentioned without advising against it: wherever surgery, an implant, filler, Botox or a prescription drug comes up, say "We don't recommend it for appearance" and give the main risks

What About Injections, Fat Freezing and Surgery: The section names deoxycholic acid injections, liposuction and face-lifts with only partial risks (nodules, adverse events, anesthesia) and no adequate main-risk summary for each. Fat-freezing is neither advised against nor given any risks, and 'talk to a professional before considering' reads as a neutral next step.

FAQ (injection safety): The answer gives only nodules and off-area adverse events. It omits the main risks of the procedure and ends with 'before considering any procedure', which leaves injections as a neutral option rather than firmly advising against them for appearance.
